rationale: This change strengthens existing permanent/trusted CI policy enforcement so every Current Host workflow and every workflow containing an explicit Current Host marker is automatically checked for immutable 40-hex GitHub Action pins. During fail-closed validation, seven additional Current Host-adjacent workflows with 17 legacy tag-based Action references were discovered and converted to the repository's canonical immutable Action SHAs. Workflow triggers, permissions, jobs, runners, commands, runtime/provider behavior, host-resource allocation, hardware behavior, proof recipes, evidence semantics and promotion authority remain unchanged. The change only removes mutable CI dependency references and prevents their recurrence; therefore no fresh physical Current Host requalification or FULL-525 replay is required.
